name: Losartan
description: An angiotensin II type 1 receptor blocker approved for hypertension, diabetic nephropathy and stroke risk reduction in left ventricular hypertrophy. It also has a mild uricosuric effect. Boxed warning for foetal toxicity.

systems.note: Blood pressure reduction through angiotensin receptor blockade; the labelled indication.
Diabetic nephropathy progression reduction is a labelled indication in its own right.
Hyperkalaemia and creatinine rise are labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled creatinine rise from reduced filtration pressure.
The albuminuria endpoint behind the nephropathy indication.
Mild uricosuric effect distinguishes this agent within the class.
